people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

translations.web: Yahweh has done to you as he spoke by me. Yahweh has torn the kingdom out of your hand, and given it to your neighbor, even to David.
translations.bsb: He has done exactly what He spoke through me: The LORD has torn the kingdom out of your hand and given it to your neighbor David.
translations.kjv: And the LORD hath done to him, as he spake by me: for the LORD hath rent the kingdom out of thine hand, and given it to thy neighbour, even to David:
translations.asv: And Jehovah hath done unto thee, as he spake by me: and Jehovah hath rent the kingdom out of thy hand, and given it to thy neighbor, even to David.
